title: Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard
headline: Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard
ai_overview: Coding agents work in tasks, and the number that matters is cost per solved task, not price per token. In this post, you use the AWS CDK to deploy LiteLLM with the NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard routing plugin on Amazon Bedrock, then measure cost per solved task for a routed model group against single-model baselines.
